Add the spinach and cook, stirring, for a further 2 minutes. Season to taste.
Serve topped with yogurt, and lemon juice, then sprinkle with coriander and enjoy!
recipe.prep_notes: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.

recipe.name: Tuna and Veggie Patties

ingredients.name: tuna in olive oil, drained weight

instructions: Squeeze out the excess water from the grated zucchini and carrot (you may want to leave it to drain in a colander for a while, or alternatively pat dry with a paper towel).
In a bowl, whisk the egg with a fork. Add the tuna, parmesan and bread crumbs and mix well. Next stir in the carrot, zucchini and spring onion. Season with salt and pepper.

Divide mixture into 2 patties per serve. Place a fry pan over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the patties to the frypan and flatten them with a spatula. Cook for 2 minutes on each side, or until patties have turned a golden brown and are cooked through.
Serve on a plate and squeeze over lemon juice. Enjoy!

recipe.name: Lemon tuna patties
instructions: Place tuna, onion, coriander and lemon zest in a bowl and mix lightly with a fork. Add egg yolks (reserving whites for later) and continue to mix. Season lightly. Sift flour into mixture, and gently fold through.
Place the egg whites in a clean bowl and whisk until soft peaks form. Spoon the whites into the tuna mixture and gently fold through. With slightly wet hands, form the mixture into 8 patties.

Heat oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add patties and cook for 5 minutes each side, or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve tuna patties with a mixed-leaf salad tossed with an oil-free dressing.

recipe.name: Dark choc raspberry bliss balls
instructions: Place the dark chocolate and coconut oil into a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave uncovered in 1-minute bursts on High (100%), stirring every minute with a metal spoon until melted and smooth. Set aside for 5 minutes to cool.
Place the pitted dates, almond meal, desiccated coconut, and cacao powder into a food processor. Pulse until the dates are finely chopped.
Add the raspberries and melted chocolate mixture to the food processor and pulse until the mixture almost comes together.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until firm enough to roll.
Roll the mixture into 36 small balls (approximately 20 g each) and place onto a tray.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until firm. Dust with extra cacao powder before serving (3 chilled bliss balls per serve).
recipe.prep_notes: Bliss balls will keep for 10 days in an airtight container in the fridge, or can be frozen for up to 3 months. Dust with extra cacao powder before serving if needed.

recipe.name: Black Bean and Dark Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat a fan forced oven to 180°C.
In a food processor or blender, process the oats into a flour. Place to one side.
Combine the black beans and olive oil in the food processor or blender, and process until it forms a paste with no chunks remaining.

Return the oat flour to the food processor, along with the bean paste, baking powder, sea salt, cocoa powder, brown sugar, egg and vanilla extract. Process, slowly pouring the milk in until it forms a batter.

Create a double boiler by placing a glass bowl over a saucepan with a little boiling water. Add 60 g of the dark chocolate chips to the bowl and stir regularly until melted. Slowly pour the melted chocolate into the batter and mix through.
Pour into a 20 cm x 20 cm square baking tray lined with baking paper. Top with the remaining 30 g of dark chocolate chips.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through. Leave to cool before slicing into six even portions.

recipe.name: White Bean and Cauliflower Soup
instructions: In a pot, saute onion and garlic for a few minutes before adding the cauliflower. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beans and stock and bring up to a simmer - cook for another 10 minutes - until cauliflower is softened.
Remove from heat and blitz with a stick blender until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking.
Serve topped with parmesan and pumpkin seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat and serve. Batch cook and freeze in portions for up to 2 months. Defrost and reheat before serving.

recipe.name: Steak with Creamy Beans

ingredients.name: tinned butter beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and sauté the leeks and garlic over a low heat for 12-15 minutes, until soft.
Add the beans and enough water just to cover then simmer for 8-10 minutes, until the beans are very soft.
Meanwhile, heat a griddle until very hot and cook the steaks to your liking.
Stir the parsley, yogurt, extra virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper into the beans.
Slice the steak into large chunks and serve on a bed of creamy beans.

recipe.name: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cook the couscous according to package instructions.
Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining olive oil and onion. Cook for 4 minutes, or until softened. Add the garlic and capsicums and cook for a further 2 minutes.

Stir in the olives and red wine, and cook for 2 minutes to reduce the red wine slightly. Add the tomatoes, bring to a simmer and return the chicken to the pan. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Top couscous with the chicken mixture. Season with salt and pepper then sprinkle with the parsley.
recipe.prep_notes: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze in portions for up to 2 months.

recipe.name: Peanut Butter and Choc Smoothie
instructions: Place all ingredients, including ice, into a blender.
Blitz until completely smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and enjoy immediately, or store in the fridge overnight and shake well before drinking.
recipe.prep_notes: Can be made the night before for an easy grab-and-go breakfast. Shake well before drinking.
